tasks.title: Number of sprayer flights
tasks.solution: Area per flight S = V/q, number of flights = ⌈A/S⌉ = ⌈A·q/V⌉. The module's example: 40 ha, 15 L/ha, 40 L → S = 2.667 ha, ⌈15⌉ = 15 flights. Round up only: the last partial tank is a flight too.

tasks.title: SPRAY_PUMP_RATE for the application rate
tasks.solution: The required flow is Q(v) = q·B·v·60/10,000 L/min, the pump duty = Q(v)/Q_max·100 %. AC_Sprayer sets duty = v·SPRAY_PUMP_RATE, so SPRAY_PUMP_RATE = q·B·0.6/Q_max — the speed cancels out. Example: 15·7·0.6/16 = 3.94; saturation at 100/3.94 = 25.4 m/s.

tasks.title: GSD from the field of view
tasks.solution: Frame width on the ground = 2H·tan(HFOV/2), GSD = width / W_px. The module's example: 2·100·tan(30.6°) = 118.3 m, 118.3/2592 = 4.56 cm/px.

tasks.title: Maximum distance for a thermal measurement
tasks.solution: A pixel at a distance D covers s = D·p/f. The condition 3s ≤ L gives D_max = L·f/(3p). Example: 0.10·0.013/(3·12·10⁻⁶) = 36.1 m. Without the factor of 3 it would come out three times larger — one point per target, which mixes the target and the background.

tasks.title: Number of aircraft in a flat show picture
tasks.solution: ⌊W/d⌋ + 1 nodes across the width, ⌊H/d⌋ + 1 across the height, and their product is the number of aircraft. Example: 60 × 30 m, 3 m spacing → 21·11 = 231. A common mistake is forgetting the +1 and losing the edge rows (200 instead of 231).

tasks.title: Required delivery flight time
tasks.solution: t = 2d/v + 2h/v_line + t_hover; required time = t/(1 − reserve). Example: 2·8000/15 + 60 + 60 = 1187 s = 19.8 min; /0.7 = 28.3 min. More than 40 min is no longer a multirotor but a VTOL.
